title: SurgicGuide CMO Dr. Chan Kin-lam Delivers Invited Lecture at Jinan University
html:
SurgicGuide Limited is pleased to share that our Chief Medical Officer, Dr. Chan Kin-lam, was recently invited to deliver an academic lecture at Jinan University.

During the session, Dr. Chan presented “Fluorescence Lifetime Imaging and AI for Precision Cancer Surgery,” introducing the principles and potential clinical applications of Fluorescence Lifetime Imaging Microscopy (FLIM) and artificial intelligence (AI) in cancer surgery.

The lecture explored how advanced optical imaging technologies can provide additional molecular and functional information beyond conventional imaging approaches. Dr. Chan also discussed how AI-assisted analysis may help translate complex imaging data into actionable information for clinicians, with the longer-term goal of supporting real-time guidance during tumour resection.

The event brought together students, researchers, and members of the academic community for an engaging discussion on emerging technologies in precision medicine and surgical oncology. The presentation was followed by a constructive exchange of ideas, with discussions covering the challenges of translating innovative imaging technologies from research settings into clinical practice.

We are grateful to Jinan University for the invitation and for providing an opportunity to exchange knowledge and perspectives with the university community.

At SurgicGuide, we remain committed to advancing the intersection of biotechnology, medical imaging, and artificial intelligence, with the aim of developing innovative technologies that can support surgeons and contribute to the future of precision cancer care.
